objective: Improve offline_vault graph traversal efficiency using an indexed visited set

mutation_count_semantics.interpretation: The record identifies one selected mutation within a batch with a recorded count of 10. The source does not establish whether mutation_count means generated, evaluated, selected, or applied mutations.

benchmark.measurement_scope: Synthetic graph traversal phase only; machine dependent

derived_metrics.interpretation: The recorded timings imply approximately 6.30 times the graph-phase throughput and an 84.12% reduction in graph-phase time for this local synthetic measurement. These results do not establish an end-to-end or production speedup.
